name: Did you select the security controls based on risk, threats and exposure?
conditionsText:
When:
- Threat assessments have been completed.
- Risks have been identified.
- Security architecture is being defined.
When:

requirementTitle: Did you select the security controls based on risk, threats and exposure?
requirementDescription: Did you choose security controls because they address real threats and risks, rather than simply applying controls because they are standard or familiar?
why: Secure by Design promotes a risk-driven approach. Controls should directly relate to the threats facing the service. Over-securing wastes money, while under-securing leaves vulnerabilities exposed
tasks: Did you select the security controls based on risk, threats and exposure?

actions.title: Did you select the security controls based on risk, threats and exposure?
actions.description:
You should be able to demonstrate:
• Threats were identified.
• Risks were assessed.
• Controls were selected to reduce those specific risks.
• Control decisions can be traced back to identified risks.
